conventions.convention: The Lorentz signature is (-,+,+,+), coordinates use x⁰=ct, e=E/c and b=B, and the sourced Maxwell sign is ∇ₐFᵃᵇ=-μ₀jᵇ, equivalently d⋆F=μ₀ιⱼvol_g.
The EOS is smooth on an open interval J with ε+p(ε)>0 and 0<p′(ε)<1; N=N_* exp(∫[ε_*,ε] dz/(z+p(z))), with ε_*∈J and N_*>0; j=cNZu and g(u,u)=-1 with u future-directed.
The classical finite-regularity branch requires a C³ Lorentz metric and C² fields F, ε, u and Z; its equations are pointwise classical equations.
The enthalpy coordinate is r(ε)=∫[ε_*,ε] sqrt(p′(z))/(z+p(z)) dz, and c_s=sqrt(p′(ε)) is dimensionless. Positive fluid symbols use timelike covectors ζ with ζ(u)>0.
K(X,Y)=g(∇_Xn,Y) for the future unit normal. Harmonic initialization uses p_ij=2K_ij, p_00=-2 tr_h K and p_0i=h_iℓ h^jk Γ(h)^ℓ_jk.

The torus branch assumes AC_ω and Dependent Choice, integer s≥5, h∈H^(s+1), and K,e,b,ε₀,u₀,Z₀∈H^s. It replaces the preceding smooth-data requirements and does not assert smoothness of nonsmooth data.
Normal charge is Q_n=-(1/c)∫g(j,n)vol_h=∫NZ(-g(u,n))vol_h. Its vanishing requires the sourced Gauss constraint on a compact oriented slice without boundary.

load_bearing.statement: The strict charged barotropic system has j=cN(ε)Zu, T_m=(ε+p)u⊗u+pg, ∇ᵃT_m,ab=F_bc jᶜ and uᵃ∇ₐZ=0, coupled to dF=0, d⋆F=μ₀ιⱼvol_g and G+Λg=κ(T_m+T_EM), with the stated strict EOS, normalization, units and smooth or classical finite-regularity domains.

Assuming Countable Choice, the strict smooth fluid equations admit the stated enthalpy reduction. Their principal bilinear form is Q_ζ((a,v,z),(a′,v′,z′))=ζ(u)(aa′+g(v,v′)+zz′)+c_s(aζ(v′)+a′ζ(v)); it is symmetric and positive definite for every timelike covector ζ with ζ(u)>0. The Lorentz force is algebraic and Z contributes an uncoupled transport block.
Smooth fields satisfying the strict system obey u(ε)+(ε+p)∇ₐuᵃ=0, ∇ₐ(Nuᵃ)=0 and ∇ₐjᵃ=0. Conditional on the stated sourced Maxwell-stress identity, ∇ᵃ(T_m,ab+T_EM,ab)=0.

Assuming AC_ω and Dependent Choice, complete strict admissible charged-fluid initial data satisfying the displayed Einstein and sourced Maxwell constraints have the stated local harmonic torus Sobolev development, with reduced-system uniqueness under common compact admissible bounds, and a smooth local geometric development on arbitrary smooth oriented boundaryless Σ, unique near the initial surface up to a data-fixing time-orientation-preserving isometry matching all matter fields.
Smooth charged-fluid initial data satisfying div_h e=-μ₀g(j,n) on a compact oriented smooth boundaryless three-manifold obey Q_n=0; no existence assertion for the other constraints is made.

concerns.concern: Proof step 5.1 says that along a normal integral curve, 'with any increasing parameter λ', the residual equations are q′+(∇ₐnᵃ)q=0 and r′+(∇ₐnᵃ)r=0. These formulas hold for the flow parameter satisfying γ′=n. For γ′=a(λ)n they require the factor a(λ) multiplying ∇ₐnᵃ; in coordinate time that factor is 1/n⁰. Choosing the flow parameter, or inserting the chain-rule factor, immediately completes the zero-data argument.

alerts.finding: In F3 the item says the mathematical development proof 'uses the exact CP02 field-strength block [L1] and CP01 Maxwell-stress identity [L2]'. Its L2 names lem-emg-maxwell-stress-conservation, whose Statement assumes smooth fields. The actual thm-emg-local-charged-barotropic-development instead names lem-emg-classical-maxwell-stress-identity as L2 and expressly avoids the smooth-only interface for its finite-Sobolev solution. The main development conclusions match, but this supporting citation description is stale.

seams_checked.note: Checked CP02 supplier statements against CP03 uses. The Maxwell symbol is used with its stated orientation and signs; the algebraic sourced current leaves its principal block unchanged. The C¹ classical stress identity supports the finite-regularity branch. Both external suppliers were opened and are draft; their use does not assert publication or independent acceptance.

The physical postulate matches the smooth strict-fluid definition, and the physical theorem restates the local-development branches, constraints and conventions faithfully. Its F3/L2 description misidentifies the stress supplier actually used by the mathematical theorem, as recorded in the alert.
